Development and validation of an UPLC-MS/MS method for the simultaneous determination of fexofenadine and olmesartan in human serum: Application to in vivo pharmacokinetic studies. A sensitive, reproducible, robust, high-throughput ultra-performance liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (UPLC-MS/MS) method was developed and validated for the simultaneous quantification of fexofenadine and olmesartan in human serum.
